mapper.select: select from mark_open_api_credential c left join sys_user u on u.user_id=c.user_id left join sys_user agent on agent.user_id=c.assigned_agent_id where c.api_key=#{apiKey} limit 1
select from mark_open_api_credential c left join sys_user u on u.user_id=c.user_id left join sys_user agent on agent.user_id=c.assigned_agent_id where c.id=#{id}
mapper.update: update mark_open_api_credential set status=#{status},update_time=now() where id=#{id}
update mark_open_api_credential set last_used_time=now() where id=#{id}
update mark_open_api_credential set name=#{name},assigned_agent_id=#{assignedAgentId},expire_time=#{expireTime},update_time=now() where id=#{id} and credential_type='CUSTOMER'
mapper.delete: delete from mark_open_api_credential where id=#{id} and credential_type='CUSTOMER'
mapper.select: select platform_code from mark_open_api_credential_platform where credential_id=#{credentialId}
select o.platform_code from mark_order_item i join mark_order o on o.id=i.order_id where i.id=#{itemId}

select distinct u.user_id as userId,u.user_name as userName,u.nick_name as nickName from sys_user u inner join sys_user_role ur on ur.user_id=u.user_id inner join sys_role r on r.role_id=ur.role_id and r.role_key in ('agent','mark_agent','mark_sub_agent') where u.del_flag='0' and u.status='0' order by u.user_name asc,u.user_id asc

select count(distinct u.user_id) from sys_user u inner join sys_user_role ur on ur.user_id=u.user_id inner join sys_role r on r.role_id=ur.role_id and r.role_key in ('agent','mark_agent','mark_sub_agent') where u.user_id=#{userId} and u.del_flag='0' and u.status='0'
